zh: 每个维度互相独立地限流，但一条请求是否放行取决于所有维度；而且只有被放行的请求才占用额度，被拒绝的请求不能计入任何维度的历史。
对每个维度，按字段值分别维护一个已放行请求时间戳的队列。时间戳非递减，所以过期的总是队首，可以像滑动窗口一样从队首弹出。
处理请求时，先对每个维度把对应队列中 ≤ now−window 的时间戳弹掉（窗口是 [now−window, now)，等于 now−window 的也算过期）；再检查是否每个维度的队列长度都小于该维度的 limit。全部满足才输出 ALLOW，并把 now 追加到所有维度的对应队列；否则输出 REJECT 且不记录。每个时间戳最多入队出队一次，总时间 O(qd)。
en: Each dimension limits independently, but whether a request is allowed depends on all dimensions together; and only allowed requests use quota, so a rejected request must not enter any dimension's history.

For each dimension, keep a separate queue of allowed-request timestamps per field value. Timestamps are non-decreasing, so expired entries are always at the front and can be popped like a sliding window.

For a request, first pop from each dimension's matching queue every timestamp <= now - window (the window is [now - window, now), so one equal to now - window has expired); then check that every dimension's queue length is below that dimension's limit. Only if all pass, output ALLOW and append now to the matching queue of every dimension; otherwise output REJECT and record nothing. Each timestamp is enqueued and dequeued at most once, so the total time is O(qd).

explanationEn:
## Approach

For each dimension, maintain a deque of allowed request times keyed by the field value. When handling a request, first remove expired times that are <= now-window, then check whether every dimension's current count is below its limit. Only if all dimensions pass is the time recorded in every dimension.

## Correctness

The sliding window is defined as [now-window, now), so an old request exactly at the boundary now-window must expire. Checking dimension by dimension guarantees that any single dimension over its limit causes a rejection; appending records only for requests allowed overall implements exactly the quota semantics this site specifies.

## Complexity

Each request checks at most d dimensions; each timestamp is enqueued and dequeued at most once in a deque. Total time O(qd), space O(qd).
